How to make the best hot cocoa in the world... Like I said in the video... it all comes down to choosing the best chocolate.Any hot chocolate is going to be good, but if you really want to treat yourself to something great, give this recipe a try.  Recipe for 2 Cups: 1 1/2 c Whole Milk 1/2 c Heavy Cream 1 tsp Powdered Sugar 200g High Quality Dark Chocolate* *If you prefer milk chocolate, go for it. If you like even darker chocolate, try that. I found these little chocolate gems from Hu while researching this recipe, and they were great. No chopping necessary. (Not sponsored btw) -Heat everything together on the lowest heat possible, whisking regularly to make sure nothing burns on the bottom.  -Heat until everything is perfectly smooth, and the serve with whipped cream, marshmallows, or however you like it.  NOTE: If you're using a chocolate with a stabilizer in it, the hot cocoa will thicken as it heats up, so add some more milk to thin it out. The ingredient ratios above only really work for pure chocolate.  #hotcocoa #hotchocolate #dessert #chocolatchaud #chocolate

🍫✨ VIRAL HEALTHY TWIX BARS Homemade • No refined sugar • Crunchy • Gooey caramel • Dark chocolate coating These homemade healthy Twix bars taste even better than the original 😮‍💨 A crunchy almond cookie layer topped with creamy peanut butter caramel and coated in rich dark chocolate with a touch of fleur de sel. Sweet. crunchy. chocolatey. And made with simple ingredients. If you love: Twix bars • chocolate desserts • healthy sweets • homemade candy bars • viral recipes this one is a must. ⸻ ✨ HOW TO MAKE HEALTHY TWIX BARS 1️⃣ Almond Cookie Base 🍪 Mix together: • 1 cup almond flour • 1 tbsp cornstarch • ¼ tsp sea salt • 2 tbsp coconut oil • 2 tbsp maple syrup • ½ tsp vanilla extract Press into a lined pan. ⸻ 2️⃣ Bake ✨ Bake at 350°F (175°C) for about 20 minutes until lightly golden. Let cool completely. ⸻ 3️⃣ Creamy Caramel Layer 🍯 Mix until smooth and creamy: • ¼ cup peanut butter • ¼ cup tahini • 2 tbsp coconut oil • 2 tbsp maple syrup Spread over the cookie base. ⸻ 4️⃣ Freeze & Slice ❄️ Freeze for 30 minutes, then cut into bars. ⸻ 5️⃣ Chocolate Coating 🍫 Dip each bar into melted dark chocolate and finish with: • fleur de sel Freeze again until the chocolate hardens perfectly. ⸻ Crunchy cookie. Creamy caramel. Rich chocolate shell. Homemade Twix… but healthier. Would you try these? 🤤 #chocolatebar #viralrecipe #easyrecipe #healthydessert #chocolatelovers
